name: Glassmorphism CSS Generator
summary: Free generator that builds glassmorphism CSS: adjust blur, transparency and colour with a live preview, then copy the CSS.
description: A free browser tool for the frosted-glass look: move the Blur slider, set Transparency and pick a Colour tint while a live preview updates, then copy the generated CSS onto any element. The effect relies on backdrop-filter (with a -webkit- prefix for older Safari), and the page suggests a more opaque fallback background for browsers without support. The site also links a ready-made CSS glass effect snippet with a dark variant; 69.8K uses, last updated October 2, 2026.
